parsed.text: Panel p0 current estimates (inherited/copied prior records) place red mass on the top-left 2x2 block at node n0 and blue mass on the top-right 2x2 block at node n0; nodes n1–n3 are uniform for both roles. Candidate command records are conditional, not events. Under candidate k0 the node-n0 distributions match the current n0 peaks; other nodes are uniform. Under candidate k1 all nodes and roles are uniform. Under candidate k2 node n0 is highly concentrated: red peak at cell [0,0] and blue peak at [0,2]; nodes n1–n3 remain uniform. Copied or inherited origins in the packet indicate which current entries were copied from prior records; conditional entries (k0, k1, k2) are labeled as command estimates and represent alternative conditional distributions, not executed outcomes.
